primary.title: Warm Autumn - Rich, Earthy, Golden
primary.description: You have a warm, golden undertone with natural depth and richness. Earthy, autumnal shades create harmony and bring out warmth in your complexion.

strong.title: Strong Warm Autumn - Deep & Defined
strong.description: Your undertone and depth are clearly warm and rich. Deep earthy tones will consistently enhance your complexion. Layered warm neutrals and textured fabrics will feel especially elevated.
strong.style_note: Lean into depth and richness. Avoid high contrast black/white combinations.

borderline.title: Between Autumn & Spring - Warm with Lift
borderline.description: You show warmth with moderate brightness. You may enjoy both soft rust tones and brighter coral accents. Try pairing one muted earthy shade with one fresher warm accent.
borderline.style_note: Experiment with warmth first, then adjust brightness level.

primary.title: Cool Summer - Soft, Elegant, Refined
primary.description: You have cool undertones with a naturally soft, slightly muted quality. Dusty, blended tones create elegance and harmony around your face.

strong.title: Strong Cool Summer - Pure Soft Cool
strong.description: Your colouring strongly favours cool and muted tones. Harmonious, blended outfits will look intentional and refined. Sharp contrast may overpower you.
strong.style_note: Keep outfits cohesive and softly blended rather than high-contrast.

borderline.title: Between Summer & Winter - Cool with Flexibility
borderline.description: You lean cool but may handle slightly stronger tones. Try both soft slate shades and occasional jewel accents to see which feels most balanced.

primary.title: Cool Winter - Bold, High Contrast, Striking
primary.description: Your colouring supports clear, saturated, cool tones. Strong contrast and vivid hues enhance your natural clarity.

strong.title: Strong Cool Winter - High Impact
strong.description: You handle bold colour exceptionally well. Clear, saturated tones and strong contrast will energise your appearance. Black is likely one of your strongest neutrals.
strong.style_note: Do not shy away from vivid statement colours.

borderline.title: Cool with Moderate Contrast
borderline.description: You lean cool but may not require extreme contrast. Test mid-tone jewel shades alongside darker neutrals to find your sweet spot.

primary.title: Warm Spring - Fresh, Bright, Luminous
primary.description: You have a warm undertone with natural brightness. Clear, lively colours bring warmth and energy to your complexion.

strong.title: Strong Warm Spring - Bright & Clear
strong.description: You benefit from brightness and warmth together. Fresh, clear colours will instantly lift your complexion.
strong.style_note: Keep colours lively and avoid overly muted palettes.

borderline.title: Warm with Moderate Brightness
borderline.description: Your undertone is warm but not extremely bright. Try balancing softer warm neutrals with one lively accent shade.
borderline.style_note: Adjust brightness level based on how vibrant you prefer to feel.
